items.title: Jane Jarvis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And my favorite bands at that time, when I was a teenager, were the McKinney Cotton Pickers, Fletcher Henderson, Lucky Millinder and then Duke.

ctx.x: Who were the players that grabbed your ear?

Well first of all you see I played organ. By this time I was accomplished somewhat on the organ. And so I looked at everything from an orchestral point of view. And my favorite bands at that time, when I was a teenager, were the McKinney Cotton Pickers, Fletcher Henderson, Lucky Millinder and then Duke. I imagined Duke may have come in there earlier. And Earl “Fatha” Hines, not so much for his band but he was a remarkable pianist that really caused all jazz pianists to re-think what they were doing. He you know,…
